shortDescription: Manage snapshot policy on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System

options.name: compliance_count_critical
options.description: If the number of valid snapshots falls below this number, the compliance changes to critical (red).

options.name: compliance_count_warning
options.description: If the number of valid snapshots falls below this number, the compliance changes to warning (yellow).

options.name: interval
options.description: The value of the interval counter for snapshot policy execution.

options.name: new_snapshot_policy_name
options.description: New name of the snapshot policy.

options.name: offset_mins
options.description: Defines when, within the interval the snapshots will be taken for a specified snapshot policy. The offset must be less than the interval of the snapshot policy. The format must be in minutes. If not specified, default value is 0.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: secure
options.description: Secure snapshots may only be terminated after they expire or by Dell Technologies support. If not specified, default value is False.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: snapshot_count
options.description: The max snapshot count of the policy. Max value is 1024.

options.name: state
options.description: Shows if the snapshot policy should be present or absent.

options.name: storage_group_state
options.description: The state of the storage group with regard to the snapshot policy. present-in-policy indicates associate SG to SP. absent-in-policy indicates disassociate SG from SP.

options.name: suspend
options.description: Suspend the snapshot policy. True indicates snapshot policy is in suspend state. False indicates snapshot policy is in resume state.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
